title: Issue 82
description: patternProperties alone never forbids other property names - that is what additionalProperties: false is for, and it is checked against both `properties` and `patternProperties`. Try "Add property" with a name matching ^[0-9]+$ (e.g. `1`) to see it accepted, then with a name that matches neither (e.g. `test`) to see it rejected inline instead of silently creating a property that only fails validation afterwards.
